title: Make cache and reconciliation behavior bounded
description: Ensure query caches, process caches, background jobs, and port-forward reconciles have bounded size/lifetime and do not block shutdown or retain stale state indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: All long-lived maps/timers have a documented eviction or cancellation policy
Cache invalidation covers deploy, stop, restart, settings, and error transitions
Reconcile operations coalesce concurrent calls and resolve within a configured bound
Shutdown clears timers and in-flight work without unhandled rejections

steps.description: Test cap eviction, TTL expiry, invalidation, concurrent reconcile coalescing, and shutdown completion with deterministic timers.

steps.details: Search the app and packages for Maps, Sets, intervals, timers, and reconciliation promises; record ownership and lifecycle.
Add or correct caps/cancellation only where evidence shows a gap; preserve existing TTL/config behavior where already compliant.

steps.description: Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, lint, and a shutdown fixture.

technicalNotes: Do not add a new global scheduler if an existing sampler/maintenance owner exists; extend the owner and make shutdown observable.
